scams.name: The San Lorenzo Fake-Leather Market
scams.description: San Lorenzo market stalls and surrounding leather shops sell imported Made-in-China PU/faux-leather goods and counterfeit Gucci/Prada/Balenciaga/LV/Fendi bags as 'genuine Italian leather.' R/florence locals warn 'every item you see outside the central market and center roads is cheap fake stuff created to scam tourists.' Guardia di Finanza cases: a San Lorenzo stall arrest (3 Italians arrested, 1 Chinese denounced); a €100,000 counterfeit-bag seizure in the historic center (4 Chinese denounced); a 49-person 'filiera del falso' investigation copying Armani/Balenciaga/Celine/Fendi/Givenchy/Gucci/LV/Prada; plus Campi Bisenzio and Osmannoro pelletteria raids grossing up to ~€1 million. A separate r/firenze thread documents a 'pay-but-never-shipped' variant at a Florence leather store.
scams.avoidance: Buy only from established Florentine workshops: Scuola del Cuoio (Santa Croce monastery), Peruzzi, Madova, Bojola, or Il Bisonte. Ignore San Lorenzo stalls unless you want a cheap souvenir; lowball aggressively. Never buy 'designer' brands from Florence stalls — all are counterfeit and Guardia di Finanza seizes them routinely. Carry purchases out in person; refuse any 'we'll ship it home' offer. Price-check against Scuola del Cuoio's online catalogue before paying over €150.
scams.location: Mercato di San Lorenzo stalls (Via dell'Ariento, Via Sant'Antonino, Piazza del Mercato Centrale); surrounding leather shops and 'factory outlet' storefronts

scams.name: Duomo & Battistero Pickpocket Duos
scams.description: Two-person pickpocket teams target tourists' backpacks and bags in Piazza del Duomo, Piazza San Giovanni and the Via Calzaiuoli/Via de' Pecori/Via dei Vecchietti/Via de' Tornabuoni corridor. Arrest record: March 16, 2026 La Nazione (2 Bulgarian women, 23, Via dei Vecchietti); March 2025 La Nazione (3 offenders aged 71/55/31, Italian/Hungarian/Romanian, Via Calzaiuoli); August 28, 2024 La Nazione (2 Bulgarian women 28 and 36, Via de' Pecori, €730 recovered); June 5, 2023 La Nazione (Romanian couple 47 and 49, Via de' Tornabuoni, €900 stolen). Tour guide Marco Verzi (Federagit Confesercenti Firenze) reported a pickpocket's threat: 'Se mi rovini il lavoro ti taglio la gola.'
scams.avoidance: Wear your backpack on your chest in Piazza del Duomo and Via Calzaiuoli — zippers toward your sternum. Never carry wallet/phone/passport in outer pockets; use inside zip pockets, a money belt, or a body pouch. Compose Duomo photos before stopping — take the photo, pocket the phone, then look up. If anyone enters your body space, step back one pace and put a hand on your bag. Shout 'ladri!' the instant you feel a brush — Florence Carabinieri on patrol make fast arrests.
scams.location: Piazza del Duomo, Piazza San Giovanni (Battistero), Via dei Calzaiuoli, Via de' Pecori, Via de' Cerretani, Via dei Vecchietti, Via de' Tornabuoni

scams.name: The Santa Maria Novella Station Pickpocket Ring
scams.description: Coordinated pickpocket teams and hustlers work Santa Maria Novella (SMN) platforms, underground passages, ticket-machine hall, taxi queue and immediate piazzas. A late-2025 r/florence local PSA describes nightly robberies 'for the last three nights in a row… someone screaming, crying, realizing they've just been robbed.' A February 12, 2026 ANSA report documents a 19-year-old arrested at SMN with an elderly Florentine's silverware, €250 cash, antique coins and two Beretta pistols stolen via a 'finto poliziotto' scam. Taxi queue issue: April 2025 r/florence 'undeclared strike' where drivers refuse short fares from the rank.
scams.avoidance: Exit via the main Piazza della Stazione side, not the rear. Use only the signed official taxi rank or walk 120m to the Alamanni tram stop (T1/T2, €1.70). Use only Trenitalia or Italo apps or operator-branded ticket machines — never let a 'helper' touch your card. Keep luggage on the facing end-of-carriage rack on Frecciarossa/Italo. Walk directly from platform to street; consult your phone outside the station with your back to a pillar.
scams.location: Santa Maria Novella (SMN) station — platforms, underground passages, ticket-machine hall, taxi queue; Piazza della Stazione; Piazza Santa Maria Novella; Via degli Avelli; Via del Giglio

scams.name: The "Tre Campanelle" Shell Game at Ponte Vecchio
scams.description: Three-shell/three-card street gambling scam with accomplice 'winners' in the crowd. Operators work in teams of 6–7 (one mazziere plus compari). January 12, 2026 Repubblica Firenze: Baschi Verdi denouncements at Via de' Cerretani/Via dei Rondinello. November 17, 2025 Corriere Fiorentino: undercover Finanza agents in Piazza del Duomo fined a Romanian operator €400. Firenze Today documents Ponte Vecchio and Piazzale Michelangelo operations. San Lorenzo shopkeepers funded 50+ bilingual 'Il gioco è una truffa!!!' placards. A Corriere Fiorentino first-person piece documents the truffatori physically shoving a witness who warned an Asian tourist.
scams.avoidance: Do not stop to watch, bet, or stand within three meters of any shell-game mat at Ponte Vecchio, Piazza del Duomo, Borgo San Lorenzo or Piazzale Michelangelo. Report live mats to Guardia di Finanza (117). Ignore friendly 'tourists' who claim to know the trick — they are compari. Warn other tourists verbally but do not physically engage operators. Trust San Lorenzo's bilingual warning placards.
scams.location: Ponte Vecchio, Piazza del Duomo, Via de' Cerretani, Via dei Rondinelli, Borgo San Lorenzo, Piazzale Michelangelo; occasionally Santa Maria Maggiore and Palazzo Vecchio

scams.name: The Outdoor Restaurant & Mercato Centrale Bag-Snatch
scams.description: Bags hung on chair backs at outdoor tables and left on Mercato Centrale communal benches are snatched by passing pedestrians or distraction-team accomplices. La Nazione (September 20, 2024): tourist pickpocketed during lunch at a Florence pizzeria. La Nazione's shopkeeper round-up flags Osteria dei Buongustai (Via de' Cerchi) where Japanese diners' bag was taken during peak lunch, Fioreria Signoria ('È un continuo borseggiare turisti'), Eugenio Calzature (Via del Proconsolo, €300 taken from the register), and Le Vanità perfumery ('Quasi tutti i giorni ho ladri in negozi'). Mercato Centrale snatches occur even in non-crowded moments.
scams.avoidance: Always place your bag on the floor with one strap looped around your chair leg or ankle — never on the chair back or an empty seat. Inside Mercato Centrale, keep your bag on your lap or in a chest-worn daypack. Sit with your back to a wall, facing foot traffic. Leave your passport in the hotel safe. Freeze cards in-app immediately if a bag disappears — the cash-out window is 3–10 minutes.
scams.location: Outdoor tables on Via de' Cerchi, Via dei Neri, Piazza Santo Spirito, Piazza Santa Croce, Piazza Santa Maria Novella; Mercato Centrale (San Lorenzo); pizzerie around the Duomo

scams.name: The Piazza della Signoria Coperto & Tourist-Menu Trap
scams.description: Restaurants facing the major piazze add unmarked per-person coperto (often above €3), a 12–15% automatic 'servizio' on foreign cards, unrequested pane/acqua/olive/antipasti, and fish or steak priced 'al etto' (per 100g) that arrives as 400–700g portions. A variant splits the bill into part-cash/part-card to dodge VAT on the cash portion. R/ItalyTravel distinguishes two severities: a 'few restaurants where you will leave feeling as if you've been scammed — deceptive prices, aggressive waiters' versus a broader ring that is 'modestly overpriced.' Italian law requires every restaurant to post a full menu with prices outside — a missing menu is legally non-compliant.
scams.avoidance: Walk 5 minutes off the Signoria/Duomo axis — Oltrarno (Piazza Santo Spirito, San Frediano), Sant'Ambrogio, or streets north of Sant'Ambrogio market are locally recommended. Photograph the outside-posted menu before sitting; if fish/steak are 'al etto' only, ask for per-gram confirmation in writing. Ask the waiter to confirm coperto and servizio at seating. Refuse unsolicited bread/water/antipasti with 'niente grazie.' Trust Italian-language Most-Recent Google reviews over English reviews.
scams.location: Restaurants facing Piazza della Signoria, Piazza del Duomo, Piazza della Repubblica, Piazza Santa Croce, Piazzale Michelangelo; Via Calzaiuoli; Via Por Santa Maria

scams.name: The SMN Taxi "Strike" & Airport Flat-Rate Overcharge
scams.description: Florence airport (FLR/Peretola) drivers quote 'flat fares' above the official €22 daytime or €25.30 night/holiday fixed rate; SMN rank drivers refuse short fares during an 'undeclared strike' (April 2025 r/florence PSA: '30 minutes' wait, user had to have a hotel call). 'Card reader is broken' scam forces ATM detours with driver watching the PIN. Short-change tricks (a handed €50 substituted for a €10 via sleight of hand, per r/ItalyTravel). Unlicensed NCCs approaching at SMN and FLR offering 'fisso' rides are another layer.
scams.avoidance: From FLR Peretola take the Tramvia T2 to SMN Alamanni stop — €1.70, ~22 minutes, nothing to negotiate. For taxis, use only official white vehicles at the signed rank and confirm €22 daytime / €25.30 night/Sunday airport fixed fare before closing the door. Call 055-4242 or 055-4390 for radio taxis or use itTaxi/FreeNow apps. Always demand a ricevuta. Refuse any ATM detour — pay the posted fare in cash, photograph the taxi number, and report to 055-055.
scams.location: Santa Maria Novella station taxi rank; Florence Peretola (FLR) Amerigo Vespucci Airport rank; hotel-called radio taxis in the historic center

scams.name: The Uffizi "Free" Bracelet, Rose & Painting Ambush
scams.description: 'Free' bracelets tied on tourists' wrists then cashed for €10–€20; roses pressed into partners' hands with a follow-up €15 demand; cheap prints laid on the pavement in tourist walking paths with a scream for €50 'damages' if you step on one. R/mildlyinteresting's top comment on the prints version names it exactly: 'They plop these big mats on the ground right in the path and if you step on one they try and get you to pay for it… mostly saw men doing this in front of the museum where David was kept.' Firenze Today documents a YouTuber physically assaulted after denouncing the prints scam in the historic center — refusing is fine, engaging or filming can turn into confrontation.
scams.avoidance: Keep your hands in your pockets in Piazza del Duomo and Piazzale degli Uffizi — no outstretched palm, no wrist to tie a bracelet on. Say 'no grazie' firmly, do not make eye contact after, and keep walking. If a bracelet gets on, pull it off and drop it — they rarely chase. Hand back a rose within the first second or leave it on the table with 'non lo voglio.' Do not engage or film the 'painting' operators — just step around the prints.
scams.location: Piazzale degli Uffizi, Piazza della Signoria, Piazza del Duomo, Ponte Vecchio, Piazzale Michelangelo, Santa Croce and San Lorenzo steps, outside Galleria dell'Accademia
